glow.at: a ring inset around the top edge

name: Critter pad
notes3d: Cheapest and most repeated piece: no undercut, no tiny detail. Glow ring on its own emissive material so the engine can recolor it per critter and dim it when empty. Pivot centre of the base.
purpose: The round stand one critter sits on (6 to 30 per den); glows in the critter's color in-engine.
